messages:
Alex K.: quick question — do we want saved-query exports to carry telemetry sampling settings? i.e. export + import should preserve sampling % and mask rules so teams don't accidentally double-sample or leak PII.
Maria P.: yes we should. PM view: saved queries are config + metadata. sampling is part of the query behavior. but needs UX — users expect export to be shareable. should be opt-in.
Jordan L.: technically easy to include a `telemetry` block in the saved query payload. proposal: {\"sampling_rate\":0.1, \"redaction_profile\":\"email-hash\"}. default export excludes it unless `include_telemetry: true`.
Sam (DevEx): UX concern: if someone imports a query with sampling=100% it could spike costs. need a clear warning and maybe a safe cap per org on import.
Alex K.: +1 on cap. Also routing/quotas tie in — if saved view pins a route and a model we should surface the route quota and whether the view will hit dedicated vs hosted.
Maria P.: that's important. Product idea: export.json includes `route_hint` and `quota_impact_estimate` fields so the receiving org can preview cost/limits. We should be careful not to leak internal quota IDs.
Jordan L.: we can include estimates only (tokens/hour, cost/day) and a `route_policy` enum (e.g. \"prefer_dedicated\", \"balanced\", \"low_cost\"). no identifying IDs.
Sam (DevEx): for embedding saved queries in docs (iframe/embed) we need a compact share token. That token should not include sampling settings unless the embed owner consents.
Alex K.: operation question: can the console show a warning banner when a view's saved telemetry differs from org defaults? e.g., "This saved query requests 50% telemetry sampling, your org default is 10%." small CTA: accept / cap / cancel.
Maria P.: yes — rollout plan: beta for internal power users, then opt-in for org admins. Need API contract for `GET /saved_queries/:id?include_telemetry=true` and `POST /saved_queries/import` with `enforce_caps`: boolean.
Jordan L.: internal API shape suggestion: saved query JSON top-level keys: `id`, `name`, `query`, `filters`, `view_prefs`, `telemetry` (optional), `route_hints` (optional), `quota_estimate`. Sample snippet:

{
  "name": "latency-by-model",
  "query": "route:payments AND model:*-v2",
  "telemetry": {"sampling_rate":0.25, "redaction": "mask_emails"},
  "route_hints": {"preferred_tier": "dedicated"},
  "quota_estimate": {"tokens_per_hour": 12000}
}

Sam (DevEx): suggest default import behavior: if telemetry present, set to min(telemetry.sampling_rate, org.max_import_sampling) and log a banner. Also add an admin audit event.
ingest-bot: imported-saved-query id=SQ-445: user=alex.kim enforce_caps=true result=applied_sampling=0.1
Alex K.: need to finalize copy for warning banners + the admin flow. Jordan, can you draft the API schema? Sam, can you draft UX copy for the banner and embed consent modal?
Jordan L.: will drop a PR with OpenAPI schema today.
Sam (DevEx): I'll mock banners and the embed consent — will post screenshots in #design later.
Maria P.: +1. plan: 1) API schema + backend caps, 2) console banner + import flow, 3) embed consent and token rules, 4) beta rollout. tagging @security for review on telemetry export.
Alex K.: thanks — looping security and infra next. short follow-ups in thread.
